website_info.name: Texly
website_info.tagline: 100+ Free Online PDF, Image, Text, and Developer Tools
website_info.description: Texly is an all-in-one platform offering professional-grade tools for AI image generation, background removal, face swapping, PDF management, text analysis, cleaning, converting, and developer utilities. Completely free, with no sign-up or installation required.

app_info.name: Texly Android App
features: Fast response and clean user interface
100% Free with zero ads inside the app

major_tools.name: Free AI Face Swap Online
major_tools.description: Swap faces between two images instantly with professional realism. Powered by advanced neural networks.

major_tools.name: Free AI Background Remover
major_tools.description: Remove backgrounds automatically in 1 click with hair-level precision. Perfect for products and avatars.

major_tools.name: AI Image Generator (Text to Image)
major_tools.description: Create stunning artwork, graphics, and realistic photos from simple text descriptions in seconds.

major_tools.name: AI Image Upscaler & Enhancer
major_tools.description: Fix blurry photos and upscale images up to 4x resolution with advanced AI sharpness.

major_tools.name: AI Text Suite
major_tools.description: An all-in-one text suite including a grammar checker, paraphraser, humanizer, summarizer, and tone changer.

major_tools.name: Snapchat Tag Generator
major_tools.description: Add 'Restored from Snapchat' or 'Restored from Camera Roll' tags in the authentic black bar overlay style.

major_tools.name: YouTube Channel Analyzer
major_tools.description: Analyze any YouTube channel to check SEO scores, subscriber metrics, video counts, and FAQs.

major_tools.name: Robots.txt Tester
major_tools.description: Test and validate robots.txt rules for web crawlers like Googlebot to ensure correct site SEO indexation.

major_tools.name: JSON Path Finder
major_tools.description: Extract specific keys, values, and paths from complex JSON payloads using JSONPath expressions.

major_tools.name: Regex Explainer
major_tools.description: Input any complex Regular Expression and get an instant, human-friendly line-by-line breakdown of how it works.

faqs.question: Who created Texly?
faqs.answer: Texly was created by Mahendra Mirdha (email: texlyonline@gmail.com). He designed the platform to help users perform text and image operations for free.

faqs.question: Is Texly free to use?
faqs.answer: Yes! Every tool on Texly is 100% free with no hidden charges, no premium subscriptions, and no registration or signup required.

faqs.question: How do I download the Texly Android App?
faqs.answer: You can download the Texly App from our official download page: /download. The app is about 14.9 MB and allows offline access to all our text utilities!
